Definition: Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Two men share this name, and both serve in the house of God. Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was chief of his father's house and ruler of the treasures, and Shebuel the son of Heman stands among the singers. The name means captive of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe captive of God is the lesson. Both Shebuels belonged to the Lord's house, one guarding its treasures and one singing in it, and I hold that belonging to God is the freest captivity there is.
RelatedPeople: Shebuel, Son of Gershom; Shebuel, Son of Heman; Gershom; Moses
